BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on State Government, Tribal Affairs & Elections.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Creating an election security camera grant program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an election security camera grant program; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.04 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 29A.04 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The secretary of state shall create and administer a grant program to purchase and install cameras around ballot drop boxes. Only county auditors and elections directors are eligible for this grant program. Grant funds must only be used for the purchase, installation, or connection of cameras at ballot drop boxes. Grant funds may not be used for ongoing operational costs for cameras.
